name: How long does shower seat installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does shower seat installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a shower seat can vary depending on the type of seat and the complexity of your existing shower. A simple wall-mounted, fold-down seat might take a professional a few hours, especially if the wall studs are easily accessible. More involved installations, such as building a custom tiled bench seat or modifying the shower enclosure, could take one to two days, or even longer if it's part of a larger bathroom renovation. Our contractors will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes a few hours for simple fold-down seats, and one to two days or more for custom or built-in bench seats.
